data.gender_notes: Jatin is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit jaṭā, 'matted hair' — jatin, 'an ascetic'. Its root is Sanskrit jata (जट). A classical Sanskrit term for an ascetic. Jatin is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ascetic; one who is restrained”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jatin expresses “Ascetic; one who is restrained”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit jaṭā, 'matted hair' — jatin, 'an ascetic'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jatin total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jati' meaning 'race, kind, class'. In Vedic literature, the term 'jati' refers to a group or category of people, and is also used to describe various divine beings and their attributes. Jatin can be seen as a name that embodies the spirit of conquering or being victorious over one's group or category.
